signature.name: VTask.comp
signature.type: {ι : Type u_1} -> {A : Type u_2} -> {B : Type u_3} -> {C : Type u_4} -> {σ : Type u_6} -> {τ : Type u_7} -> {ψ : Type u_8} -> [Semiring A] -> [Semiring B] -> [Semiring C] -> [SetLike σ A] -> [SetLike τ B] -> [SetLike ψ C] -> {𝒜 : ι → σ} -> {ℬ : ι → τ} -> {𝒞 : ι → ψ} -> (g : ℬ →+*ᵍ 𝒞) -> (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) -> 𝒜 →+*ᵍ 𝒞

conventions.statement: VTask.comp g f applies f first and g second, matching standard mathematical right-to-left composition notation (g ∘ f), consistent with RingHom.comp.
conventions.note: This is a notational convention, not a junk-value convention.

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} {A B C : Type*} {σ τ ψ : Type*} [Semiring A] [Semiring B] [Semiring C] [SetLike σ A] [SetLike τ B] [SetLike ψ C] {𝒜 : ι → σ} {ℬ : ι → τ} {𝒞 : ι → ψ} (g : ℬ →+*ᵍ 𝒞) (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ), (VTask.comp g f).toRingHom 1 = 1

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} {A B C : Type*} {σ τ ψ : Type*} [Semiring A] [Semiring B] [Semiring C] [SetLike σ A] [SetLike τ B] [SetLike ψ C] {𝒜 : ι → σ} {ℬ : ι → τ} {𝒞 : ι → ψ} (g : ℬ →+*ᵍ 𝒞) (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (a b : A), (VTask.comp g f).toRingHom (a * b) = (VTask.comp g f).toRingHom a * (VTask.comp g f).toRingHom b
